Premium fares from Tokyo

Latest full capture: 3 Nov 2026 19:00 Tokyo time, 8 searches on Google Flights, 96 prices recorded. Every price is for one adult, round trip from Tokyo (Narita or Haneda), 7 nights, in US dollars, as the source showed it at the capture time; taxes included.

Words used on this page
Round trip from
The source lists outbound flights, each with the cheapest round-trip price that includes it. The return flight is not chosen yet.
Nonstop
One flight, no change of plane. One-stop: one change of plane on the way out.
via
The airport where you change planes, as a three-letter airport code (FRA = Frankfurt).
Typical
The middle value (median) of the cheapest price found on each earlier day: half the days were cheaper, half dearer. A price well below it is cheap for this route; whether it is a deal is the verdict.
Verdict
The line at the top of each route: today's cheapest nonstop or one-stop trip against a good-price line (Dan's own number, else the lowest tenth of 60 or more days of our prices, else reported sales), read as a deal (at or under it), not a deal, or no good-price line yet.
Week scan
The daily capture searches one departure every two weeks, always on the same weekday, so a separate search of seven days in a row (four weeks out, business) shows which days each nonstop flies. A nonstop that is sold out or not offered on a day searched will not show on that day.
Mixed cabins
A first class search can return a trip that is first class on the long flight but business (or lower) on a connecting flight, because few short flights have a first class cabin. Such trips are marked with the cabin of each outbound flight.
Capture
One run of the searches; each price is stamped with the time it was seen and where.
